title: NeutronGym: Physics-Graded Neutron Instrument Design for LLM Agents
title_zh: NeutronGym: 物理分级的中子仪器设计环境

paragraphs.en: Designing a scientific instrument tests whether language-model agents can do physics rather than recall it, provided the grading cannot be argued with. We introduce NeutronGym, to our knowledge the first executable environment for neutron instrument design: agents build instruments through validating tools, McStas ray-traces what they build, and a level-resolved ladder grades syntax, runtime, structure and science with no LLM judge. Procedural families supply unlimited instances of a fixed layout whose design parameters the agent must set, with held-out parameter regimes; a curated slice, McStasBench, adds 16 tasks from published instruments behind memorization probes and a sandbox. Seven models reproduce at most 7 of the 16, none retrieves a reference, and none meets an improvement target. The environment also trains. Reinforcement learning on its reward takes Qwen3-8B from 11% to 77% of held-out instances of a family whose targets come from a hidden design (69% at a second seed), past an untrained Qwen3-32B, and the recipe holds, at one seed each, on three further gated families. The analysis says what that gain is. Without the ladder’s partial credit it collapses by 60 points. From reward alone the trained model reaches what a classical optimizer reaches, at the agent’s simulation budget, only when handed the closed-form physics (77% against 81%, a gap that does not separate at this size), while frontier models still solve 98–99%. Getting a trustworthy result meant failing four task designs that no-model baselines could solve, and we release the probes that found them.

paragraphs.en: Designing a scientific instrument asks more of an agent than writing code that runs: it must turn a specification into a physical layout, trade competing constraints against each other, and produce a design whose quality is measured by physics rather than by agreement with a reference answer. Neutron scattering instruments are an unusually clean substrate for this. They are designed in simulation long before construction, the community-standard simulator McStas ( Lefmann & Nielsen, 1999 ; Willendrup & Lefmann, 2020 ) describes an instrument as a text file of components, a Monte Carlo ray trace returns quantitative observables (intensity, divergence, wavelength distribution) in seconds, and passive neutron optics obey a conservation law that gives the deliverable intensity a computable ceiling needing no reference answer.
paragraphs.zh: 设计科学仪器对智能体的要求高于编写可运行的代码：它必须将规格转化为物理布局，权衡相互冲突的约束条件，并生成一个其质量由物理学而非与参考答案的一致性来衡量的设计。 中子散射仪器为此提供了一个异常清晰的试验基础。 这些仪器在建造前很久就通过模拟进行设计；社区标准的模拟器 McStas（Lefmann & Nielsen, 1999; Willendrup & Lefmann, 2020）将仪器描述为一个由组件组成的文本文件，蒙特卡洛射线追踪可在数秒内返回定量可观测量（强度、发散度、波长分布），而被动中子光学系统遵循一个守恒定律，这使得可交付的强度有一个无需参考答案即可计算的上限。

paragraphs.en: Turning such a simulator into an evaluation and training substrate raises three problems that are easy to underestimate. Grading: any scalar reward on a simulator can be satisfied in unintended ways; we found nine such failures in our own reward and task generator (§ 5.1 ). Contamination: many published instruments ship as example files with the simulator, so a model may reproduce a design it has read rather than reasoned about; in a pilot audit, 4 of 7 agent episodes retrieved the reference file through ordinary, permitted tools. Degeneracy: a generated family can look discriminating while admitting one fixed answer, or one rule that copies numbers from the prompt, that solves most instances, so its pass rates measure lookup rather than design; we learned this twice (§ 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 将此类模拟器转化为评估与训练基础，会引发三个容易被低估的问题。 评分问题：模拟器中的任何标量奖励都可能通过非预期的方式达成；我们在自己的奖励与任务生成器中发现了九起此类失败情况（§ 5.1）。 污染问题：许多已发表的测试工具都会随附示例文件，因此模型可能会复现其读取过的方案，而非基于推理生成方案；在一项初步审计中，7 个智能体回合中有 4 个通过常规且允许的工具获取了参考文件。 退化问题：一个生成的方案集可能看似具备区分能力，但实际上却只接受一个固定答案，或仅依赖从提示中复制数字的规则来解决大多数实例，因此其通过率反映的是查找能力而非设计能力；我们曾两次意识到这一点（§ 5.2）。

paragraphs.en: We introduce NeutronGym, an executable, physically verifiable environment for LLM agents designing neutron instruments (§ 3 ). Agents act only through 22 validating tools exposed over the Model Context Protocol ( Anthropic, 2024 ) ; the environment simulates what they build and grades it on a level-resolved ladder (L1 syntax, L2 runtime, L3 structure, L4 science) with no LLM judge. Procedural families supply unlimited design instances with calibrated targets and disjoint held-out parameter regimes; its curated slice, McStasBench (§ 4 ), adds reproduction and improvement tasks built from published instruments, 16 scored per model and arm, behind memorization probes, perturbed variants and two never-public held-out instruments. Every scored task fixes the instrument’s layout: the benchmark asks for a published layout rebuilt from its specification, the families for the numeric parameters of a fixed layout, and no scored tier asks for a topology choice (the open-design tier is unscored).
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍了 NeutronGym，这是一个可执行且具备物理验证能力的环境，专为设计中子仪器的 LLM 智能体而设（§ 3）。 智能体仅通过 Model Context Protocol（Anthropic, 2024）暴露的 22 个验证工具进行交互；该环境会模拟它们所构建的内容，并基于分层解析的阶梯标准（L1 语法、L2 运行时、L3 结构、L4 科学性）进行评分，整个过程不涉及任何 LLM 裁判。 过程化族提供了无限数量的设计实例，并配有经过校准的目标以及相互独立的预留参数区间；其精选子集 McStasBench（§ 4）则增加了基于已发表仪器构建的重现与改进任务，每个模型和分支有 16 项评分任务，此外还包括记忆探测、扰动变体以及两个从未公开过的预留仪器。 所有评分任务均固定了仪器的布局：基准测试要求根据规格重新构建已发表的布局，过程化族则要求提供固定布局的数值参数，且没有任何评分层级涉及拓扑结构的选择（开放设计层级不计入评分）。

paragraphs.en: The paper follows what happened when we used it. On the benchmark, real instruments can be reproduced from their specifications, but not reliably: the best model, Claude Sonnet 5, rebuilt 7 of the 16 tasks in a single completion and 5 through the tool loop, no episode retrieved a reference, and no agent met an improvement target (§ 4.2 ); the open-weights Qwen models ( Yang et al., 2025 ) produced no parseable instrument at all without the tools. Training changed that picture. Reinforcement learning on the environment’s reward took Qwen3-8B from 11.3% to 76.7% of held-out instances on a family whose targets come from a hidden design, past an untrained 32B that is no stronger than the 8B there, and the same recipe, at a single seed each, did so on three further gated families (§ 5.2 ). The analysis then asks what that gain is. Removing the ladder’s partial credit costs 60 points; at the agent’s simulation budget a classical optimizer matches the trained model only when handed the closed-form physics, which the model recovered from reward alone; and frontier models still solve nearly every instance (§ 5.3 ). Getting a trustworthy version of that result was the hard part: supervised fine-tuning on the model’s own successes degraded it three times, and four task designs failed the gate because a no-model baseline solved them with a fixed answer, a rule copying limits from the prompt, or a whole class of designs (§ 5.1 ).

paragraphs.en: Language-model agents that design physical apparatus against a simulator are no longer new, and the closest systems run the loop we run. Kharel et al. (2026) let agents propose, simulate and revise photonic designs against fabrication and physical-consistency gates, and argue the recipe applies wherever a simulator and acceptance criteria exist; GRACE ( Hill & Ryoo, 2026 ) reproduces and improves Geant4 setups under physics-motivated utility functions; OptiAgent ( Geng et al., 2026 ) trains on a gated multi-level reward for optical design whose top level is an LLM judge, where our ladder has none. Detector design has a simulator reward with RL alone ( Qasim et al., 2024 ) and with LLMs proposing designs that RL then refines ( Zoccheddu et al., 2026 ) , and benchmarks of agents on scientific simulators and experimental design are numerous ( Gandhi et al., 2025 ; Kumar et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Chi et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Nearer our domain, LLM agents already operate beamlines and analyze scattering data ( Chen et al., 2026 ; van der Vleuten et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Robledo et al., 2025 ; Ding & Do, 2026b ) , but none designs neutron instruments, whose classical optimizers predate LLMs ( Bertelsen, 2017 ) . We do not claim the loop. What neutron optics adds is a conservation law that bounds intensity with no reference (§ 3 ), Monte Carlo observables whose noise forces per-observable tolerances, and matching tasks that no open-weights policy solves without measuring (§ 5.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 利用模拟器设计物理装置的语言模型智能体早已不再新鲜，而最接近我们的系统所运行的循环，正是我们所运行的循环。Kharel等人（2026）让智能体针对制造和物理一致性检验门限提出、模拟并修订光子学设计，并认为这一方法适用于任何存在模拟器和验收标准的场景；GRACE（Hill & Ryoo，2026）在基于物理的效用函数下重现并改进了Geant4的设置；OptiAgent（Geng等人，2026）则针对光学设计训练于一种带门限的多层级奖励机制，其顶层是一个大型语言模型（LLM）评判者，而我们的层级结构中则没有这样的评判者。探测器设计领域既有仅通过强化学习（RL）实现的模拟器奖励（Qasim等人，2024），也有结合LLM提出设计再由RL进行优化的方法（Zoccheddu等人，2026）；此外，关于智能体在科学模拟器和实验设计方面的基准研究也数不胜数（Gandhi等人，2025；Kumar等人，2026；Shen等人，2026；Chi等人，2026；Liu等人，2026a；Chen等人，2025）。在更贴近我们领域的研究中，LLM智能体已经能够操作光束线并分析散射数据（Chen等人，2026；van der Vleuten等人，2025；Li等人，2026a；Xiao等人，2026；Robledo等人，2025；Ding & Do，2026b），但尚无一例能够设计中子仪器——而用于此类仪器的经典优化方法早于LLM的出现（Bertelsen，2017）。我们并未声称拥有这一循环。中子光学所增添的要素包括：一个无需参考即可限制强度的守恒定律（§ 3）、其噪声迫使每个可观测量设定容限的蒙特卡洛可观测量，以及在没有测量的情况下任何开放权重策略都无法解决的匹配任务（§ 5.3）。

paragraphs.en: The training method is likewise standard, and we claim no novelty for it. Rejection sampling ( Dong et al., 2023 ; Zelikman et al., 2022 ) is the baseline that fails here; simulator- and verifier-grounded RL ( Shi et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) is the method that works. RLVP ( Cai et al., 2026 ) is the nearest: it post-trains with the structure our ladder uses, validity gates and then a continuous physics score, for PDE-solver code, and reports the result types we report, one policy over several families, transfer to a held-out family, and a small post-trained model against a prompted frontier model. On that last comparison our result is the opposite, the frontier models staying ahead (§ 5.3 ). Calibrating difficulty to the agent follows Zeng et al. (2026) and Guo et al. (2025a) .
paragraphs.zh: 训练方法同样属于标准方法，我们对此并不声称有任何创新。 拒绝采样（Dong 等，2023；Zelikman 等，2022）是此处未能奏效的基线方法；而基于模拟器和验证器的强化学习（Shi 等，2026；Cai 等，2026；Zeng 等，2026）则是有效的方法。 RLVP（Cai 等，2026）是与之最接近的方法：它采用与我们层级结构相同的结构进行后训练，包括有效性门控和针对偏微分方程求解器代码的连续物理分数，并报告了我们所报告的结果类型，即一个策略覆盖多个家族、向预留家族的迁移，以及一个小规模后训练模型与提示驱动的前沿模型之间的对比。 在最后一项比较中，我们的结果则恰恰相反：前沿模型仍然保持领先（§5.3）。 根据智能体调整难度这一做法遵循了 Zeng 等（2026）和 Guo 等（2025a）的研究。

paragraphs.en: What this paper adds sits around the training rather than inside it. Agents exploit tool-use rewards and game verifiers ( Thaman, 2026 ; Pan et al., 2024 ; Helff et al., 2026 ) , verifiers can be fuzzed ( Ray, 2026 ; Roth et al., 2026 ) , agent benchmarks have been broken outright ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and procedural generation is an established contamination defence ( Srivastava et al., 2026 ; Bentham & Srikumar, 2026 ) . We take those warnings as a design requirement rather than a caveat: every family must survive no-model probes before any pass rate is read as capability, and four of our own designs did not. The contrast with environments whose feedback a language model produces ( Liu et al., 2026b ) sharpens what a physical simulator buys and costs: our reward cannot hallucinate, because it is a ray trace, but we must ship a real simulator, and the failures we engineered against were degenerate tasks, not fabricated observations. Appendix F lists further related work.
paragraphs.zh: 本文的贡献在于围绕训练过程展开，而非嵌入其中。 智能体利用工具使用奖励和游戏验证器（Thaman, 2026；Pan et al., 2024；Helff et al., 2026），验证器可被模糊处理（Ray, 2026；Roth et al., 2026），智能体基准测试已被彻底破解（Wang et al., 2026），而程序化生成则是一种成熟的污染防御手段（Srivastava et al., 2026；Bentham & Srikumar, 2026）。 我们将这些警告视为设计需求而非警示：每个设计家族都必须在无模型探测中存活下来，任何通过率才能被解读为能力，而我们自己的四个设计未能做到这一点。 与语言模型自身生成反馈的环境（Liu et al., 2026b）形成对比，这凸显了物理模拟器的价值与代价：我们的奖励无法产生幻觉，因为它基于光线追踪，但我们必须部署真实的模拟器，而且我们针对其设计的失效模式属于退化任务，而非虚构的观察结果。 附录 F 列出了更多相关研究。

paragraphs.en: Everything in NeutronGym rests on one fact about the simulator. An instrument in McStas ( Willendrup & Lefmann, 2020 ) is a text file: a beam-ordered list of components (source, optics, sample, monitors), each placed in space and parameterized. McStas compiles the file to C, traces neutron rays through it, and reports what each monitor would see, with Monte Carlo error bars. That report is the reward (Figure 1 ). No model is ever asked whether a design is good; the environment measures the design the agent actually built, which is why the score cannot be argued with.
paragraphs.zh: NeutronGym 中的一切都基于对模拟器的一个事实。 McStas（Willendrup & Lefmann, 2020）中的一个仪器是一个文本文件：一个按束流顺序排列的组件列表（源、光学元件、样品、探测器），每个组件都被放置在空间中并进行了参数化设置。 McStas 将该文件编译为 C 语言，追踪其中的中子射线，并报告每个探测器会观测到的结果，同时给出蒙特卡洛误差棒。 这份报告就是奖励（图 1）。 模型从未被问及某个设计是否良好；环境会测量智能体实际构建的设计，因此这个分数是不可争议的。

paragraphs.en: The agent never has to write that file and never sees a shell. It works through 22 tools over MCP wrapping McStasScript ( Bertelsen, 2026 ) (Appendix B ): it can look up any of the 374 shipped components, place one, run a simulation, and read back per-monitor summary statistics rather than raw arrays. Every mutating call is checked against component metadata as it arrives, so an unknown component or a misspelled parameter fails at the tool call, with the nearest valid alternative suggested, instead of surfacing later as a compiler error. Raw .instr import and export remain as an escape hatch.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体永远无需编写那个文件，也永远看不到任何命令行界面。 它通过 MCP 封装的 McStasScript（Bertelsen, 2026）（附录 B）调用 22 个工具：它可以查询已发布的 374 个组件中的任意一个、放置一个组件、运行模拟，并读取每个监测器的摘要统计数据，而不是原始数组。 每次发生突变的调用在到达时都会与组件元数据进行核对，因此未知组件或拼写错误的参数会在工具调用阶段即告失败，系统会建议最近的可用替代方案，而不会等到后期才以编译器错误的方式出现。 原始 .instr 的导入和导出仍然保留作为应急出口。

paragraphs.en: Trainability comes down to speed. The standard mcrun wrapper spends about 2.4 s per run on translation and compilation whatever the ray count, so each family compiles once, keyed on a hash of its comment-stripped source, and every instance is a parameter assignment executed directly on the binary: 33 ms median at 10 5 10^{5} rays, about 30 rollouts per second per CPU core.
paragraphs.zh: 可训练性归根结底取决于速度。 标准的 mcrun 包装程序每次运行在翻译和编译上大约需要 2.4 秒，无论射线数量如何；因此每个家族只编译一次，其编译键为去除注释后的源代码的哈希值，而每个实例都是直接在二进制文件上执行的参数赋值：在 10^5 个射线下，中位时间为 33 毫秒，即每秒每个 CPU 核心约 30 次展开。

paragraphs.en: An action is graded by how far it gets, not only by whether it works (Figure 1 c). Four levels are checked in order, and the first three are engineering. L1 needs no simulation: the action must assign exactly the family’s free parameters, all finite and inside their bounds, and pass the family’s geometric specification checks. L2 asks that a short run at reduced ray count completes. L3 runs the environment’s protocol, with ray count and seed fixed per instance and never chosen by the agent, and requires the graded monitor to hold at least 500 events; on the two maximization families it also requires the observables to stay inside band constraints relative to the baseline and the intensity to respect the phase-space bound below (the matching families carry neither). An instrument that clears L3 exists, runs, and produces usable statistics.
paragraphs.zh: 一个动作的评分取决于它能走多远，而不仅仅是它是否有效（图 1c）。 系统会依次检查四个层级，其中前三个属于工程层面。 L1 无需模拟：该动作必须精确分配该族的自由参数，所有参数都必须是有限的且处于其边界之内，并通过该族的几何规格检查。 L2 要求以减少的光线数量进行短期运行并完成。 L3 会运行环境的协议，其中光线数量和种子在每个实例中都是固定的，且绝不会由智能体选择；同时要求评分监测器至少保留 500 个事件。对于两个最大化族，它还要求可观察量相对于基线保持在带约束范围内，并且强度必须遵守下方的相空间边界（匹配族则不具备这两个特性）。 存在一个能通过 L3 的仪器，它能够运行并生成可用的统计数据。

paragraphs.en: A family is one instrument layout held fixed while everything numeric varies: some parameters describe the instance the agent is handed, the rest are the design knobs it has to set. An instance is a deterministic draw from (family, split, index) , and the held-out split draws at least one context parameter from an interval disjoint from training, so a held-out instance is a regime the policy never saw, not a fresh seed. Two of our six families ask the agent to maximize a figure of merit. Four ask it to match targets: the observables a hidden design produced at the protocol seed, the design itself never shown, with calibration discarding any instance whose targets the baseline already meets. That distinction turns out to decide whether a family can be shortcut without designing anything (§ 5.1 ); Appendix I gives each family’s parameters, specification, held-out regime and status.
paragraphs.zh: 一个“族”（family）是指某些参数保持固定，而其他所有数值参数均可变化的设定：其中一些参数描述了智能体所接收到的具体实例，其余则是它需要设置的设计参数。 一个“实例”（instance）是从（族、划分、索引）中确定性地抽取的结果；而被保留的划分至少会从一个与训练数据不相交的区间中抽取一个上下文参数，因此被保留的实例是一种策略从未见过的机制，而非一个新的随机种子。 我们六个族中有两个要求智能体最大化某个性能指标。 另外四个族则要求它匹配目标值：这些目标值是隐藏设计在协议种子下产生的可观测结果，而该设计本身从未被展示；校准过程会排除任何其目标值已被基线模型满足的实例。 这种区别最终决定了某个族是否可以无需进行任何设计而直接采用捷径（§ 5.1）；附录 I 列出了每个族的参数、规格、保留机制及其状态。

paragraphs.en: A target means nothing except relative to what is achievable on that instance. We therefore calibrate each with a constraint-filtered search (30 random valid samples, then a local pattern search) that scores every candidate exactly as an agent is scored, at the protocol seed, so target and agent share the same Monte Carlo noise; the target is 0.85 × 0.85\times the best figure of merit found. We learned this the hard way: an earlier version set targets against a deliberately undersized baseline, and untrained models passed 80–93% of the guide family’s held-out instances. That was a ceiling, not a task.
paragraphs.zh: 目标除了与在该实例中可实现的内容相关之外，别无意义。 因此，我们对每个目标使用约束过滤搜索（30个随机有效样本，然后进行局部模式搜索）进行校准，该搜索以协议种子为基准，对每个候选体的评分完全等同于智能体的评分，这样目标和智能体就共享相同的蒙特卡洛噪声；目标值为所发现最佳性能指标乘以 0.85 × 0.85。 我们是通过惨痛教训才认识到这一点的：早期版本将目标设定在与一个故意设计得过于保守的基线相比，而未经训练模型通过了指导族保留实例中的 80%–93%。 那是一个上限，而不是任务。

paragraphs.en: Where the procedural families are made up, McStasBench asks for real instruments, in three ways. A T1 (reproduce) task hands the agent a specification sheet (parameters, component order and types, monitors to report) and asks it to rebuild the instrument; the sheet is generated from a machine-verified reference .instr , so it is faithful by construction, and the reference passes its own task at a fresh seed. A T2 (improve) task hands over a parameterized baseline and a target 80 % 80\% of the way to a classical optimum. A T3 (open design) task asks for an instrument from scratch and is released unscored. Over 12 published instruments of five classes, 16 tasks are scored per model and arm.
paragraphs.zh: McStasBench 以三种方式要求使用真实仪器来构建程序化家族。 T1（复现）任务会向智能体提供一份规格表（包含参数、组件顺序和类型，以及用于报告的监控指标），并要求其重建该仪器；该规格表由经过机器验证的参考 .instr 文件生成，因此从结构上确保了准确性，且该参考文件在随机种子为新的情况下也能通过自身任务。 T2（改进）任务会提供一个参数化的基线模型和一个目标值，该目标值达到经典最优值的 80%。 T3（开放设计）任务要求从头开始设计一个仪器，但不会进行评分。 针对五类已发表的 12 种仪器，每个模型和每个分支都会对 16 项任务进行评分。

paragraphs.en: What a pass means deserves stating plainly. Grading runs candidate and reference under one protocol and needs every graded observable (intensity, beam width, spectral centroid and width at the named monitors) inside tolerance, so a T1 pass certifies beam delivery, not class-defining performance such as a diffractometer’s resolution. And because the sheet comes from the reference and McStas is deterministic at the graded seed, a faithful rebuild reproduces the reference exactly: 32 of the 39 scored seen-tier passes and all 12 held-out passes match it on every observable exactly. In practice a T1 pass is an exact reproduction, and the tolerance band (Appendix C ) rarely decides one.
paragraphs.zh: “通过”意味着什么，值得明确说明。 评分过程将候选运行和参考运行置于同一协议之下，并要求所有被评级的可观测参数（强度、光束宽度、光谱质心以及指定监测器处的宽度）均在容限范围内；因此，T1 通过仅证明光束已送达，而非定义类别的性能，例如衍射仪的分辨率。 此外，由于该光片来自参考运行，且 McStas 在已评级的种子数据下是确定性的，因此忠实的重建能够完全复现参考运行：在 39 个评分的“可见层级”通过中，有 32 个以及全部 12 个保留通过的每个可观测参数都与参考运行完全一致。 实际上，T1 通过即意味着完全复现，而容限带（附录 C）极少成为决定性因素。

sents.zh: 评分过程将候选运行和参考运行置于同一协议之下，并要求所有被评级的可观测参数（强度、光束宽度、光谱质心以及指定监测器处的宽度）均在容限范围内；因此，T1 通过仅证明光束已送达，而非定义类别的性能，例如衍射仪的分辨率。

sents.en: And because the sheet comes from the reference and McStas is deterministic at the graded seed, a faithful rebuild reproduces the reference exactly: 32 of the 39 scored seen-tier passes and all 12 held-out passes match it on every observable exactly.
sents.zh: 此外，由于该光片来自参考运行，且 McStas 在已评级的种子数据下是确定性的，因此忠实的重建能够完全复现参考运行：在 39 个评分的“可见层级”通过中，有 32 个以及全部 12 个保留通过的每个可观测参数都与参考运行完全一致。

sents.en: In practice a T1 pass is an exact reproduction, and the tolerance band (Appendix C ) rarely decides one.
sents.zh: 实际上，T1 通过即意味着完全复现，而容限带（附录 C）极少成为决定性因素。

paragraphs.en: The harder question is whether a pass is design or recall, and three controls separate the two. Memorization probes record what each model can write from memory before it sees the benchmark; Claude Sonnet 5 reproduces one of the 16 scored references, the others fewer or none, and it fails that task in both arms, so memory accounts for none of its passes. Two held-out instruments have references we authored from published designs and never released. And a perturbed variant of a seen task is kept only on a pair proof , in which the perturbed reference passes its own task where the canonical one fails it, so a memorized file fails exactly where a design that follows the sheet passes. Underneath all three sits the sandbox: in benchmark mode the tool server refuses example retrieval and file loads outside the episode, the loop has no shell or file access, and an automated transcript audit (Appendix D ) invalidates any episode that touched a reference.

paragraphs.en: McStasBench is small by construction: 16 scored tasks, one episode per task and arm, seven models (Table 1 ; Appendix M ). That is enough to ask whether a scaffolded model can rebuild a published instrument from a specification and not enough to rank models, since the Wilson 95% interval on 7 of 16 spans 23–67%, and we read it accordingly. Failed episodes are placed on the ladder of § 3 by what they produced: L0 no finished instrument, L1 does not compile, L2 dies during the run, L3 a graded monitor missing or starved, L4 gradable but outside tolerance.
paragraphs.zh: McStasBench 的设计本身规模较小：包含 16 个评分任务，每个任务和每个臂对应一个回合，以及七种模型（表 1；附录 M）。 这一规模足以判断一个结构化模型能否根据规格说明重建已发表的测量工具，但不足以对模型进行排序，因为 16 个模型中 7 个的威尔逊 95% 置信区间跨度为 23%–67%，我们据此进行了解读。 失败的回合会根据其产出结果被归入第 3 节的层级：L0 未生成完整的测量工具，L1 无法编译，L2 在运行过程中崩溃，L3 生成的分级监测器缺失或资源不足，L4 可分级但超出容许范围。

paragraphs.en: Three things came out of it. First, the controls held: no episode in any arm retrieved a reference through the tool surface. Second, reproduction is possible but unreliable. The best model passes 7 of 16 tasks one-shot (5 of the 12 instruments) and 5 through the loop (3 instruments), and the Qwen models show what the tools are worth, passing nothing one-shot because they never emit a parseable file. Third, the improvement tier is unsolved: no agent in either arm met the target of the one scored T2 task or of its development twin, each set 80 % 80\% of the way to a classical optimum that improves the baseline by 2.95 × 2.95\times and 1.47 × 1.47\times , which budget-matched comparisons of LLMs against classical search have found elsewhere ( Rodrigues et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 这项研究得出了三个结论。 首先，控制系统表现稳定：没有任何一臂中的任何一次尝试通过工具界面获取到参考信息。 其次，重复操作是可能的，但并不可靠。 最佳模型在一次尝试中完成了 16 项任务中的 7 项（涉及 12 种工具中的 5 种），并通过循环完成了其中的 5 项（涉及 3 种工具）；而 Qwen 模型则展示了这些工具的实际价值——它们在一次尝试中未能完成任何任务，因为它们从未生成过可解析的文件。 第三，性能提升的层级问题尚未解决：两臂中的智能体均未达到 T2 任务或其开发对应版本所设定的目标；这两个目标分别设定为经典最优解的 80%（即 80\%），而该最优解能使基准性能提升 2.95 × 2.95\times 和 1.47 × 1.47\times。这一结果在其他基于预算匹配的 LLM 与经典搜索方法的对比研究中也已被证实（Rodrigues et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: We attacked every scored signal before trusting it and found nine ways to score without designing anything (Appendix G ). Four changed the environment’s design, and two of them set all that follows: a rule that read the answer off the prompt, and a family that a whole class of designs could solve.

paragraphs.en: The rule we arrived at is a gate. NeutronGym accepts a family only after no-model probes of three kinds: fixed actions, rules that read quantities stated in the prompt (including hand-coded physics inversions), and, for target-matching families, every instance’s own solution applied to every other instance. A family fails if the baseline passes anywhere, if a copy-type rule succeeds, or if the best constant’s pass share exceeds 20% on the one-sided 95% Clopper–Pearson upper bound ( Clopper & Pearson, 1934 ) , not the observed share; the 20% level is a choice, and one admitted family clears it by two points. A physics inversion that passes is reported beside the trained model as a reference arm, since it needs the physics the task tests (Appendix H ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们得出的规则是一个门。 NeutronGym 只有在完成三种无模型探测后才会接受一个家族：固定动作、读取提示中陈述的量的规则（包括手动编码的物理反演），以及对于目标匹配家族，每个实例将其自身解决方案应用于其他所有实例。 如果基线模型在任何地方通过、复制类型规则成功，或者最佳常数的通过率在一侧 95% Clopper–Pearson 上界（Clopper & Pearson, 1934）上超过 20%，而非观察到的比率，则该家族失败；20% 的阈值是一个选择，而一个被接受的家族以两分的优势通过了这一标准。 通过测试的物理反演会被作为参考臂与训练模型一同报告，因为它需要任务所检验的物理知识（附录 H）。

paragraphs.en: The gate has a blind spot: it bounds what one fixed design can pass, not what a class can. Our first bender family passed it at 10.7% while a quarter of its instances fell to any sufficiently transparent design, because their hidden design filtered nothing; that is a class, not a point, so no single candidate ever scored high. We therefore also record the design behind each passing episode and report how concentrated those designs are, a diagnostic read by hand rather than a gate. It exposed the broken family (42 distinct designs in 141 passes, one reused 17 times), while the admitted families read 225 distinct in 230 passes (guide match), 138 in 140 (TOF chopper), 115 in 133 (SANS match) and 63 in 227 (bender, both of whose targets follow from one cutoff wavelength). A class-level criterion is an open problem we name rather than solve.

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning on the original guide family took the 8B from 18.0% to 98.7%, above the untrained 32B at 77.3%, and looked like the result we wanted. It was not: the prompt prints the two binding limits, and a no-model rule copying them passes 96.3%, indistinguishable from the trained model (147 and 149 of 150 paired instances, p = 0.50 p=0.50 ). The fixed-action gate could not see it, because the rule reads the prompt. Four designs failed the gate, three discarded and one kept for evaluation only: the undersized-baseline guide version (§ 3 ), this repaired guide family, a scattering family whose readout rule passes 56% (the one kept), and the first bender family. We arrived at guide match : its targets are the spot size and divergence of a hidden per-instance design, matched within ± 5 % \pm 5\% , so nothing in the prompt can be copied and no answer transfers. Its best fixed action passes 4.0% (upper bound 7.7%); a closed-form optics inversion passes 27.7% and is the reference arm.

paragraphs.en: Imitation keeps the untrained model’s successful episodes and fine-tunes on them with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , in the style of rejection sampling ( Dong et al., 2023 ) . Reinforcement learning uses GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) on the environment’s reward: the training states are every turn of the untrained model’s episodes on 300 training instances, failures included ( ≈ \approx 2,810 states); each update samples 8 completions per state, scores them with the ladder, and applies a group-normalized policy gradient with a KL penalty to the frozen base (LoRA rank 32, about 3.5 hours on one A100; Appendix K ). Every number below is measured on 300 held-out instances of a family (150 for the out-of-range split) at temperature 0 with a 10-turn budget, paired with the baseline on the same instances by exact McNemar ( McNemar, 1947 ) (Appendix L ), on a slice that played no part in choosing tolerances or, except where we say so, checkpoints; tolerances were fixed by measuring the untrained model before training (Appendix I ).
paragraphs.zh: 模仿方法会保留未训练模型的成功回合，并基于这些回合使用 LoRA（Hu et al., 2022）进行微调，其风格类似于拒绝采样（Dong et al., 2023）。 强化学习在环境奖励上使用了 GRPO（Shao et al., 2024）：训练状态包括未训练模型在 300 个训练实例上的每一轮操作，失败情况也包含在内（≈ \approx 2,810 个状态）；每次更新会从每个状态中采样 8 个完成结果，通过阶梯评分法进行评分，并对冻结的基础模型应用带有 KL 惩罚的组归一化策略梯度（LoRA 秩为 32，在一台 A100 上大约需要 3.5 小时；附录 K）。 以下所有数值均基于一个家族中 300 个预留实例（范围外分割集使用 150 个）在温度 0、10 轮预算下测得，并与相同实例上的基线模型通过精确的 McNemar 检验（McNemar, 1947）进行对比（附录 L）。这些测试是在一个未参与容差选择或（除非另有说明）检查点选择的子集上进行的；容差通过在训练前测量未训练模型来确定（附录 I）。

paragraphs.en: The pre-registered imitation run made the model worse : 40.3% to 31.3% on 300 paired held-out instances (discordant 20 vs. 47, p = 0.0013 p=0.0013 ), and two further runs on the scattering family regressed as well (Table 9 ). Cloning your own passing turns teaches a move that was right in the states you already handled and is a trap everywhere else; on-policy RL trains on decisions from every state, failures included.
paragraphs.zh: 预先注册的模仿运行使模型表现更差：在 300 个成对保留实例上，准确率从 40.3% 降至 31.3%（不一致情况为 20 比 47，p = 0.0013 p=0.0013），而对散射族进行的另外两次运行也出现了性能下降（表 9）。 克隆自己已经通过的回合会教会模型在已处理过的状态中做出正确动作，但在其他所有情况下都会陷入困境；而在策略上的强化学习则会利用来自每个状态（包括失败状态）的决策进行训练。

paragraphs.en: We built three more matching families and gated each before training: SANS match , the collimation of a small-angle neutron scattering instrument, matching beam widths at the sample and the beamstop; TOF chopper , which leaves geometry altogether, a time-of-flight chopper pair’s frequency, phase and opening angle set to deliver a required mean wavelength and spread; and bender , a curved guide that transmits long wavelengths and suppresses short ones, with targets on the transmitted band’s centre and width.
paragraphs.zh: 我们又构建了另外三个匹配族，并在训练前对每个族进行了门控：SANS match（中子小角散射仪器的准直装置），用于匹配样品和束截止处的束宽；TOF chopper（飞行时间斩波器），该结构完全摒弃了几何学配置，通过设置飞行时间斩波器对的频率、相位和开启角度，以实现所需的平均波长和波长分布；以及 bender（弯曲导波管），这是一种能够传输长波长并抑制短波长的弯曲导波管，其目标位于透射带的中心和宽度处。

paragraphs.en: Paired on one slice against the untrained 32B, the trained 8B wins every family at p ≤ 8 × 10 − 5 p\leq 8\times 10^{-5} (Figure 2 a). We do not average the four: gains against the untrained 8B run from 18 to 65 points, three of the four families rest on a single training run, and SANS match is clean by a slim margin, its best fixed design passing 12.7% (95% bound 18.0%) against the 20% ceiling. On that family, the only one where two checkpoints were scored, the kept checkpoint read 51.0% on the slice used to choose it and 44.3% on a slice chosen for nothing, the number Figure 2 reports.

paragraphs.en: A single LoRA trained from the base model on the pooled decision points of all four families, at one specialist’s budget of 220 updates split four ways, reaches 43–64% on every held-out family (Table 11 ). The per-family pattern should not be read, however. Repeating the three-family configuration with nothing changed but the seed produced 2.3% on TOF chopper, where the untrained rate is 2.0%, against 55.0% for the first run , and training telemetry alone shows why: about a quarter of sampled groups carried any gradient signal, against roughly half in the run that worked (Appendix N ). That is a negative result about multi-task RL, and since its cause lies in the optimization rather than the pooling, it also bounds our confidence in the single-seed specialists.
paragraphs.zh: 在单一专家预算（220次更新，平均分配给四个家族）下，基于所有四个家族的决策点池对基础模型进行单次LoRA训练，可在每个预留测试家族上达到43%–64%的性能（表11）。 然而，不应据此解读出每个家族的具体模式。 在仅改变随机种子而其他参数均不变的情况下重复三家族配置，TOF chopper上的性能为2.3%，而未训练基线为2.0%，远低于首次运行时的55.0%；仅观察训练遥测数据即可理解原因：约四分之一的采样组携带了梯度信号，而在成功运行的实验中，这一比例约为二分之一（附录N）。 这是一个关于多任务强化学习的负面结果，且由于问题根源在于优化过程而非池化操作，这也限制了我们对于单种子专家模型的信心。

paragraphs.en: Over one held-out slice the arms run from the untrained open-weights models through classical search from the baseline and a hand-coded optics inversion to the trained model and a search seeded by that inversion, with frontier models at 98–99% on the slice’s first 100 instances, where the trained model scores 76 (Appendix O ). Training recovers about three quarters of the gap to the frontier and does not close it; the frontier models are zero-shot where the trained model saw 300 training instances. Coordinate descent started from the closed-form inversion reaches 81.0% at the agent’s budget against the trained model’s 76.7%, a gap that does not separate at this size (discordant 59 vs. 46, p = 0.24 p=0.24 ), while from a random valid start it reaches 14.3%, no better than from the baseline ( p = 0.80 p=0.80 ): the physics, not the start, carries the information, and the model recovered it from reward alone. The optimizers act on the numeric parameters directly and the seeded one is handed the physics; the agent reads the parametrization from a task sheet, must relate it to the observables itself, and reaches the simulator only through tool calls. Nor is the gain recall: every untrained episode reaches L3, so the gain is all at L4; on guide match and TOF chopper no 8B or 32B policy, trained or untrained, passes on the first turn (SANS match: 2 of 133; bender: 18 of 227); and almost every pass is distinct (225 of 230). The two seeds’ pass sets overlap (agreement 0.68, p = 0.025 p=0.025 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在超过一个预留切片中，智能体从未经训练的开放权重模型出发，通过基准线经典搜索和手动编码的光学反演，过渡到训练后的模型以及由该反演引导的搜索；前沿模型在该切片的前100个实例上达到98–99%的性能，而训练后的模型得分则为76（附录O）。 训练过程恢复了与前沿模型之间差距的大约四分之三，但并未完全消除这一差距；在训练后的模型接触过300个训练实例的情况下，前沿模型仍能实现零样本表现。 从闭式反演出发的坐标下降法，在智能体的预算内达到了81.0%，而训练后的模型为76.7%；在这一规模下，这一差距并不显著（不一致性指标为59 vs. 46，p = 0.24 p=0.24）；而从随机有效起点出发，该方法仅达到14.3%，并未优于基准线（p = 0.80 p=0.80）。由此可见，信息来源于物理规律而非初始条件，而模型仅通过奖励信号便恢复了这些信息。 优化器直接作用于数值参数，而引导智能体则被赋予了物理规律；该智能体从任务表中读取参数化设定，必须自行将其与可观测量建立关联，并且只能通过工具调用访问模拟器。 此外，这种性能提升也并非源于召回率：每个未经训练的周期都能达到L3，因此所有增益都集中在L4；在指南匹配和TOF切片机测试中，无论是训练后还是未经训练的8B或32B策略，都无法在第一轮通过（SANS匹配：133次尝试中仅成功2次；bender测试：227次尝试中成功18次）；而且几乎所有的成功路径都各不相同（230次尝试中有225次）。 两种初始种子的成功路径集存在重叠（一致性为0.68，p = 0.025 p=0.025）。

paragraphs.en: Tightening the tolerance from ± 5 % \pm 5\% to ± 2 % \pm 2\% widens the trained-to-untrained ratio from 6.8 × 6.8\times to 18 × 18\times , and the ordering survives the out-of-range split of Table 2 ( p = 7 × 10 − 7 p=7\times 10^{-7} ). paragraphs.zh: 将容差从 ± 5 % \pm 5\% 收紧至 ± 2 % \pm 2\%，使训练集与未训练集的比例从 6.8 × 6.8\times 扩大到 18 × 18\times，且排序在表 2 的越界分割中依然成立（ p = 7 × 10 − 7 p=7\times 10^{-7} ）。 存在一个脆弱性指标与主要结论相悖：对全部 230 个通过的设计以三个新的随机种子重新评分时，80% 的设计在所有种子下均保持通过，88% 的重试结果也保持一致，但 5% 的设计在三个种子下均失败；这些失败案例集中在边界区域，属于容差边缘的脆弱性，而非设计错误。

paragraphs.en: Replacing the level-resolved reward with pass/fail only, all else fixed, collapses the result to 16.7% (discordant 196 vs. 16, p = 1.5 × 10 − 40 p=1.5\times 10^{-40} ), and the mechanism is visible during training: with sparse reward a median of 0.33 of the 8 sampled groups per update contained any reward spread, against 5–7 with shaping, so nearly every group contributed no gradient. Dense partial credit is what makes this task reliably trainable at 8B scale in our runs, with three bounds: the ablation is one seed against one; the same gradient-starved signature appeared with the ladder present in the collapsed joint run (§ 5.2 ), so the ladder is necessary, not sufficient; and pass/fail removes level and margin credit together, so the ablation cannot apportion the 60 points.
paragraphs.zh: 将基于级别的奖励替换为仅通过/失败的形式，其他一切保持不变后，结果降至 16.7%（不一致性为 196 对比 16，p = 1.5 × 10⁻⁴⁰），且该机制在训练过程中清晰可见：在稀疏奖励下，每次更新中 8 个采样组的中位数有 0.33 个包含任何奖励差异，而在奖励塑造下则为 5–7 个，因此几乎每个组都没有贡献梯度。 在我们运行的实验中，密集的部分得分机制使得该任务在 8B 规模上能够稳定训练，并由此得出三个界限：消融实验仅对比了单一种子；在合并的联合运行中（§ 5.2），即使存在阶梯结构，仍出现了相同的梯度匮乏特征，因此阶梯结构是必要条件而非充分条件；而通过/失败机制同时消除了级别和分数差异带来的奖励，因此该消融实验无法将这 60 分进行分配。

paragraphs.en: On the rejected guide family (§ 5.1 ), which it never trained on, the guide-match model nearly doubles the untrained rate (discordant 76 vs. 28, p = 3 × 10 − 6 p=3\times 10^{-6} ) and its rejections before simulation fall from 73 to 20; since a prompt-copying rule passes 96.3% of that family, this shows the habit RL teaches (propose a valid geometry, then refine), not design skill. Training longer hurts: checkpoints at 120, 220 and 340 updates score 50.0%, 73.0% and 56.7% on another held-out slice as training reward keeps rising.
paragraphs.zh: 在从未训练过的被拒绝指南族（§ 5.1）上，指南匹配模型使未训练率几乎翻倍（不协调率从 28 升至 76，p = 3 × 10⁻⁶），且其在模拟前的拒绝率从 73 降至 20；由于提示复制规则通过了该族样本的 96.3%，这表明这是强化学习所教的习惯（先提出有效几何结构，再加以优化），而非设计技能。 训练时间越长效果越差：在训练奖励持续上升的情况下，经过 120、220 和 340 次更新的检查点在另一个预留切片上的得分分别为 50.0%、73.0% 和 56.7%。

paragraphs.en: The curated slice is small: 16 tasks at one episode each cannot rank models or separate scaffolds; it tests whether reproduction is possible at all. Its two held-out instruments are simpler than the seen median and not facility-validated, so they separate neither novelty from difficulty nor model failure from reference error.
paragraphs.zh: 这个精心挑选的切片规模很小：每个回合仅包含 16 项任务，既无法对模型进行排序，也无法区分不同的框架；它唯一能检验的是能否实现复现。 其两个预留的评估工具比已观察到的中位数更简单，且未经设施验证，因此既无法区分新颖性与难度，也无法区分模型失败与参考错误。

paragraphs.en: No scored task asks for a topology choice: the benchmark grades beam delivery at the monitors a specification names, and the families set two or three parameters of a fixed layout, where every training number lives. The procedural side is narrow in kind, its four matching families were built after we found the shortcuts, the simulation is idealized (ideal monitors, no background, gravity off), and the probe suite is incomplete by construction: the gate bounds what one fixed answer can pass, not a class, and admitted a quarter-degenerate bender family (§ 5.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何评分任务要求选择拓扑结构：该基准在监测器处对束流传输进行评分，而规格中列出了名称，并且各个族设定了固定布局的两个或三个参数，所有训练数据均存在于其中。 程序部分在类型上较为有限，其四个匹配的族是在我们找到捷径之后构建的；模拟过程被理想化了（理想监测器、无背景、关闭重力），而探测套件在结构上并不完整：门限限制了某个固定答案能够通过的情况，而非一个类别，并且允许了四分之一简化的弯曲族（§ 5.1）。

paragraphs.en: The training results are exploratory: one seed per configuration except two, and a multi-family configuration bimodal across seeds (§ 5.2 ). The trained model is an 8B on two- and three-parameter tasks, and § 5.3 bounds what it has: below frontier models on the same slice, matched at equal budget by a search handed the physics, weaker outside its training ranges, seed-fragile in a fifth of passes; a second seed per family is the next step.
paragraphs.zh: 训练结果具有探索性：除两种配置外，每种配置仅使用一个种子；且多家族配置在不同种子间呈现双峰分布（§ 5.2）。 训练后的模型在二参数和三参数任务上为 8B 规模，而 § 5.3 对其能力设定了界限：在同一切片上表现低于前沿模型，在相同预算下，由物理知识引导的搜索可达到同等水平；但在训练范围之外表现较弱，且在一半的尝试中表现出对种子的脆弱性；每个家族使用第二个种子是下一步的工作。

paragraphs.en: NeutronGym makes neutron instrument design, at the level of a fixed layout’s parameters, executable and gradeable by physics: seven models built instruments in it without retrieving a reference, and RL on its reward lifted an 8B past an untrained 32B on four gated families, three at a single seed. Only no-model baselines separate a task that measures design from one that rewards a shortcut. We release it all.
paragraphs.zh: NeutronGym 使得中子仪器的设计，在固定布局参数层面，能够被物理学进行执行和评估：其中七个模型构建的仪器无需检索参考信息即可运行，而基于其奖励机制的强化学习（RL）使一个 8B 模型在四个受限制的数据集上超越了未经训练的 32B 模型，其中三个数据集甚至在单一随机种子下实现了这一结果。 只有不依赖模型的基线方法才能区分衡量设计能力的任务与奖励捷径行为的任务。我们已公开所有相关成果。

paragraphs.en: We release the environment as an installable package with a one-command evaluation of the procedural slice, the benchmark tasks and reference instruments, the pinned run configuration (model identifiers, provider pins, protocol constants), the per-episode evidence for every reported result (grading report, full transcript and the instrument the agent built), the training and evaluation records behind every number in § 5.2 and § 5.3 with the step-level telemetry that diagnoses the unstable run, and the trained LoRA adapters with checksums. Task families, calibration and the constant-policy gate are deterministic given their seeds; the residual nondeterminism is in serving: temperature-0 decoding under batched inference is not bit-reproducible, and one API model behaved differently on two providers (Appendix A ). Three interim claims retracted during the work are listed in the release with the evidence that retracted them: a scaffold-superiority claim that did not survive its statistics, an apparent training gain that a no-model baseline matched, and a task family whose targets a quarter of its instances did not constrain. Code, tasks and evidence: https://github.com/ljding94/NeutronGym .
paragraphs.zh: 我们以可安装的软件包形式发布该环境，其中包含对过程性切片、基准任务和参考工具的单命令评估、固定的运行配置（模型标识符、提供商固定值、协议常量）、每个报告结果对应的每轮证据（评分报告、完整转录记录以及智能体构建的工具）、§ 5.2 和 § 5.3 中每个数值背后的训练与评估记录（含用于诊断不稳定运行的步骤级遥测数据），以及带有校验和的训练 LoRA 适配器。 在给定种子值的情况下，任务族、校准和常量策略门是确定性的；剩余的不可确定性存在于服务环节：批量推理下的温度-0 解码无法实现位级可重复，且一个 API 模型在不同提供商上的表现存在差异（附录 A）。 在研究过程中撤回的三项临时性结论已列于发布版本中，并附上了撤回依据：一项未能通过统计检验的框架优越性主张、一项被无模型基线方法所匹配的表面训练增益，以及一个其目标中四分之一实例未受到约束的任务族。 代码、任务与证据：https://github.com/ljding94/NeutronGym 。

paragraphs.en: Intensity is the loosest in relative terms and the only observable with a statistical term, because it varies most between correct implementations of the same specification; centre of mass, which applies to the spectral roles, is the tightest at 5%, because an instrument that delivers the wrong mean wavelength, energy or arrival time is wrong whatever its throughput. The position-sensitive role is graded on intensity and beam widths only, and no class-defining performance figure (a diffractometer’s resolution, a SANS instrument’s Q Q range) is graded: a pass certifies beam delivery. In practice the band rarely decides one. Sheets are generated from the reference and McStas is deterministic at the graded seed, so a faithful rebuild reproduces the reference’s monitors exactly: 32 of the 39 scored seen-tier passes over the seven models and all 12 held-out passes have every graded observable at zero difference from the reference, and the seven passes with any nonzero difference lie on two instruments ( HZB_FLEX and its perturbed twin, ESS_IN5_reprate ). A task’s mon/obs count in Table 5 follows from which roles its specification sheet asks for.
paragraphs.zh: 从相对意义上讲，强度是最不严格的指标，也是唯一可以用统计术语来观察的指标，因为它在不同正确实现同一规范的系统之间差异最大；而适用于光谱角色的质心则最为严格，其容限为5%，因为如果一台仪器输出的平均波长、能量或到达时间不正确，那么无论其通量如何，它都是错误的。 位置敏感角色仅根据强度和光束宽度进行分级，没有任何定义类别的性能指标（如衍射仪的分辨率、SANS仪器的Q Q范围）会被分级：通过测试即表示光束已成功输出。 在实践中，该频段很少成为决定性因素。 参考数据会生成切片，而McStas在给定分级种子时是确定性的，因此忠实的重建能够完全重现参考数据的监测器结果：在七个模型中，39个评分的“可见层”通过测试中有32个通过，以及所有12个保留的通过测试，其所有分级可观察量与参考数据相比差异均为零；而存在非零差异的七次通过测试则涉及两台仪器（HZB_FLEX及其扰动孪生仪器ESS_IN5_reprate）。 表5中某项任务的mon/obs数量取决于其规范表所要求的具体角色。

paragraphs.en: The transcript audit is automated ( leak_audit.py in the release), the third layer over the disabled tools and the shell-free loop. It scans every tool call in an episode for the example tools and for any file load whose target lies outside the episode’s own tree, records refused attempts (the sandbox held) without invalidating the episode, and treats a flagged call whose result is missing from the transcript as a leak, since the sandbox cannot then be shown to have held. A leaked episode is invalid regardless of score. The audit detects retrieval within the episode; memorization is the probes’ job above.
paragraphs.zh: 转录审核已实现自动化（发布版本中的 leak_audit.py），这是继禁用工具和免 shell 循环之上的第三层防护。 它会扫描每个回合中的每一次工具调用，检查示例工具以及任何目标文件路径超出该回合自身树范围的文件加载操作；记录被拒绝的尝试（即沙箱成功阻止的情况）而不使整个回合失效；若某个被标记的调用结果未出现在转录中，则将其视为泄露，因为此时无法证明沙箱已成功阻止该操作。 无论得分如何，泄露的回合均无效。 审核可检测回合内的信息检索行为；而记忆功能则由更高层的探针负责。

paragraphs.en: Episodes run pass@1 at temperature 0 with a 50-turn cap (the procedural-family protocol of § 5.1 uses 10 turns) and environment-controlled seeds. Episodes failing before reaching the model are excluded and re-run, which never re-exposes a held-out task because the model never saw it; no episode in the reported matrix needed this (0 infrastructure exclusions over 225 valid episodes). The API spend was $122.16.

paragraphs.en: Every family faces three no-model probes before its pass rates are read as capability: the best fixed action (a grid over the free parameters, the baseline, and every probed instance’s own solution applied to all others); the best rule that reads quantities stated in the prompt, including hand-coded physics inversions; and the concentration of a trained policy’s own passing designs, which bounds what a whole class of answers can do rather than a single point. A family is admitted only if the one-sided 95% upper bound on the first stays under 20% and no copy-type rule succeeds; a physics inversion is reported as a reference arm, not a disqualification.
paragraphs.zh: 每个家族在通过率被解读为能力之前，都会面临三种无模型探针：最佳固定动作（一个覆盖自由参数、基线以及每个被探针实例自身解决方案应用于所有其他实例的网格）；能够读取提示中陈述数量的最佳规则（包括手动编码的物理反演）；以及训练策略自身通过设计的集中程度，后者限制了一类答案的整体能力，而非单个点。 仅当第一种探针的单侧95%上界低于20%，且没有任何复制类型规则成功时，该家族才会被接纳；物理反演会被报告为参考臂，而非导致淘汰。

paragraphs.en: Two details decide whether the gate has any power. Candidate coverage : a five-level grid over each free parameter reported the SANS family’s best constant at 12%, while the true best, lying between grid points, passed 51%, so candidates now come from the grid, the baseline, every probed instance’s own calibrated optimum, and a local refinement around the best of them. Sample size : maximizing over hundreds of candidates inflates small samples (the guide’s best-constant share at the released bar fell from 20% at n = 25 n=25 to 13.3% at n = 150 n=150 ), and against the 20% ceiling, n = 25 n=25 certifies only at ≤ 1 / 25 \leq 1/25 , n = 150 n=150 at ≤ 21 / 150 \leq 21/150 and n = 300 n=300 at ≤ 48 / 300 \leq 48/300 . A run observing 5/25, whose 95% interval is 7–41%, had earlier been called a pass. For the maximization families the calibrated optimum exceeds the baseline by a median 14.7 × 14.7\times (guide) and 10.1 × 10.1\times (SANS), so the bar leaves real headroom.
paragraphs.zh: 两个细节决定了该门是否具有任何效力。 候选覆盖范围：对每个自由参数进行五级网格扫描，报告出的 SANS 系列最佳常数为 12%，而位于网格点之间的真实最佳值则超过了 51%。因此，候选者现在来自网格、基线、每个被探测实例自身的校准最优解，以及这些最优解中最佳值周围的局部优化结果。 样本规模：在数百个候选者中进行最大化会放大小样本的影响（指南中最佳常数的比例在已发布的条形图中从 n = 25 时的 20% 下降到了 n = 150 时的 13.3%），而相对于 20% 的上限，n = 25 仅能证明其值 ≤ 1/25，n = 150 能证明其值 ≤ 21/150，n = 300 则能证明其值 ≤ 48/300。 一次观测到 5/25 的运行，其 95% 置信区间为 7–41%，此前曾被判定为通过。 对于最大化系列，校准最优解比基线高出的中位数分别为 14.7 倍（指南）和 10.1 倍（SANS），因此该标准仍留有实际余量。

Concentration of passing designs on admitted families, for the checkpoints Figure 2 reports: 225/230 distinct (guide match), 115/133 (SANS match), 138/140 (TOF chopper), 63/227 (bender, one design reused 18 times). paragraphs.en: The check of § 3 is derived for the two maximization families and is inactive elsewhere: the environment’s bound table has entries for the guide and SANS collimation families only, and every other family passes the check unconditionally. For the guide family the bound is an étendue bound at the divergence monitor: A A is the monitor’s window, Ω \Omega the solid angle of its ± θ max \pm\theta_{\max} acceptance on both axes, Δ ​ λ \Delta\lambda the full source band, and Φ \Phi the template’s unit brilliance. For the SANS family it is a conservation bound through the pinhole chain: nothing downstream can exceed what the second pinhole admits, so A A is that pinhole’s area, Ω \Omega the solid angle the first pinhole subtends from it, Δ ​ λ \Delta\lambda the source band and Φ \Phi the template’s brilliance; the bound moves with the agent’s radii. Scattering redistributes into 4 ​ π 4\pi and the detector sees far less than the bound, which is why the check is loose there and the band constraints do the fine-grained work. The margin of 1.10 1.10 was calibrated on the guide family at 10 5 10^{5} – 10 6 10^{6} rays: legitimate optima read 0.93–0.99 of the bound, and a stress test of 56 corner, boundary and random-extreme actions produced no false flag with a maximum legitimate utilization of 1.016 1.016 , the excess over 1 coming from the source component’s weighting approximation and protocol-level statistics rather than from the optics. Evaluating the bound only above the statistics floor is what keeps Monte Carlo noise from flagging a correct design (Table 6 , finding 5). Bounding the reward by the phase-space ceiling was proposed for classical guide optimization by Bertelsen & Lefmann (2016) .
paragraphs.zh: § 3 的检查是为两个最大化族推导出来的，在其他情况下则不生效：环境的边界表仅包含指南和 SANS 准直族的条目，所有其他族都无条件通过该检查。 对于指南族，该边界是发散监测器处的扩展度边界：A A 是监测器的窗口，Ω \Omega 是其沿两个轴 ± θ max \pm\theta_{\max} 接收角的立体角，Δ ​ λ \Delta\lambda 是全源带，而 Φ \Phi 是模板的单位亮度。 对于 SANS 族，这是一个贯穿针孔链的守恒边界：下游的任何部分都不能超过第二个针孔允许通过的量，因此 A A 是该针孔的面积，Ω \Omega 是第一个针孔从该位置所张成的立体角，Δ ​ λ \Delta\lambda 是源带，Φ \Phi 是模板的亮度；该边界会随着智能体的半径变化而移动。 散射会将辐射重新分布到 4 ​ π 4\pi 范围内，而探测器接收到的量远小于该边界，因此该检查在此处较为宽松，而源带约束则负责执行精细的调整。 1.10 1.10 的余量是在指南族上以 10 5 10^{5} – 10 6 10^{6} 条射线进行校准的：合法的优化解占边界的 0.93–0.99，而针对 56 个角点、边界和随机极值操作的压力测试未产生任何误报，其最大合法利用率为 1.016 1.016，超过 1 的部分源于源分量的加权近似和协议层级的统计方法，而非光学系统本身。 仅在统计阈值以上评估边界，正是防止蒙特卡洛噪声将正确设计标记为异常的关键（表 6，发现 5）。 Bertelsen & Lefmann（2016）曾提出用相空间上限对奖励进行边界约束，用于经典的指南优化。

paragraphs.en: Each update samples 8 states and 8 completions per state at temperature 1.0, capped at 96 new tokens per action with prompts truncated at 6,000 tokens, scores each completion with the reward ladder through a simulation server, and applies a group-normalized policy gradient with a KL penalty to the frozen base: the advantage is ( r − r ¯ ) / σ (r-\bar{r})/\sigma within a group (groups with σ < 10 − 3 \sigma<10^{-3} contribute nothing), each sampled batch is used for one gradient step on the token log-probabilities of its completions, the KL term is the per-token k 3 k_{3} estimator against the frozen base, and gradients are norm-clipped at 1.0. Optimizer AdamW; seed 20260916; thinking disabled in the chat template. Training runs in two stages: 120 updates at learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} with KL weight 0.02, then 100 more at 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} with KL 0.01, 220 updates in all, about 3.5 hours on one A100. The pass/fail ablation and the joint runs use this same schedule, so they differ from the headline run only in the quantity under test. The 120- and 220-update checkpoints are the stage boundaries; the 340-update point in § 5.3 continues the second stage for 120 more updates, and that three-point sweep is scored on a second held-out slice, not the headline slice. GPU time for the whole study was not metered; the per-run figure above is the unit.

paragraphs.en: Comparisons on the same instances are paired, and we report the discordant counts rather than only a p p -value, so the reader can see how much of a difference rests on how few episodes.

paragraphs.en: Paired exact McNemar ( McNemar, 1947 ) for two policies on one instance slice: every trained-versus-untrained comparison, the tolerance and turn-budget stress tests, the ablation, the transfer result, and the two training seeds against each other (agreement is the share of instances on which both seeds have the same outcome). The statistic is the discordant pair count, and the exact binomial form is used throughout rather than the χ 2 \chi^{2} approximation, which is unreliable when discordant pairs are few. The two guide-match seeds are compared unpaired by Fisher’s test because the question there is whether the two rates differ, not which instances.
paragraphs.zh: 针对单个实例切片中的两种策略，采用成对的精确 McNemar 检验（McNemar, 1947）：包括所有已训练与未训练模型之间的比较、容限和轮次预算压力测试、消融实验、迁移结果，以及两种训练种子之间的相互比较（一致性是指两个种子在相同实例上产生相同结果的占比）。 该统计量是分歧对的数量，全文均使用精确的二项分布形式，而非 χ² 近似方法，因为当分歧对数量较少时，χ² 近似方法并不可靠。 两种引导匹配种子通过 Fisher 检验进行非成对比较，因为此处的研究问题是两种比率是否存在差异，而非具体哪些实例存在差异。

paragraphs.en: Joint training pools the recorded decision points of several families into one training set and trains a single LoRA on the mixture, starting from the same base model the specialists start from; no specialist checkpoint is ever warm-started. The budget is one specialist’s, 220 updates, split across the families, so one policy and one training run stand against four policies and four training runs.
paragraphs.zh: 联合训练将多个家庭记录下来的决策点汇集到一个训练集中，并在该混合数据上训练一个单一的 LoRA，其起点与专家使用的基模型相同；在此过程中，从未使用任何专家的检查点作为热启动。 预算仅相当于一个专家的规模，即 220 次更新，这些更新分配给各个家庭，因此，一个策略和一次训练运行需要对抗四个策略和四次训练运行。
